# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.68

## Added

- Backoffice RX Profile Sync can filter patients by total active RX history:
  all patients, exactly one active RX record, or two or more active RX records.

## Safety

- This is a read-only scan filter. Synchronization remains manual, audited,
  and limited to 100 selected RX records per batch. No migration or business-
  data change is included.
